grep -q 'Status: ok' /tmp/aicall-cycle20-final.start; RESULT=''; for i in $(seq 1 160); do RESULT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v raw -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S' 2>/dev/null || true); printf '%s

' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'completed_cycles=20'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'first_failed_cycle=0'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'service_pid_stable=true'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'final_prepared=false'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'final_active=false'; printf '%s
' "$RESULT" | grep -q 'final_heartbeat=false'; wait "$TPID"; TPID=''; test -s "$T"; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from s22_resource_telemetry import load_jsonl, summarize_samples
s=load_jsonl(Path('/tmp/aicall-cycle20-final.jsonl'))
h=[x.helper for x in s if x.helper is not None]
a=[x.app for x in s if x.app is not None]
print(summarize_samples(s))
print('samples', len(s), 'app', len(a), 'helper', len(h))
assert len(a) >= 3
assert len(h) >= 3
assert len({x.pid for x in a}) == 1
assert len({x.pid for x in h}) == 1
print('app_fd', a[0].fd_count, a[-1].fd_count, max(x.fd_count for x in a))
print('app_threads', a[0].thread_count, a[-1].thread_count, max(x.thread_count for x in a))
print('app_rss', a[0].vmrss_kb, a[-1].vmrss_kb, max(x.vmrss_kb for x in a))
print('helper_fd', h[0].fd_count, h[-1].fd_count, max(x.fd_count for x in h))
print('helper_threads', h[0].thread_count, h[-1].thread_count, max(x.thread_count for x in h))
print('helper_rss', h[0].vmrss_kb, h[-1].vmrss_kb, max(x.vmrss_kb for x in h))
print('cycle20_resource_evidence_green=true')
PY
